requirements: Indexing scale: ~75M clinical notes, growing 5M/month; expect peak index size ~200M docs in 18 months
Query profile: 30–100 qps sustained on business hours; burst up to 300 qps for batch analytics
Latency targets: P50 < 120ms, P95 < 400ms for embedding + rerank end-to-end
Cost sensitivity: target <= $0.03 per query (embedding + rerank amortized), otherwise look to quantize models or routing policies
PHI controls: no egress to public multi-tenant infra; audit trails for every query, per-user access controls, field-level redaction
Model preferences: open LLM for reranking (Llama2 variant or similar) in private; embedding model preference to be evaluated vs vendor baseline
Fallbacks: automatic routing to smaller quantized model if latency SLO at risk; cold-cache strategy for rarely accessed historical notes
technical_notes: Customer wants vector DB + learned reranker; preference to host vector indices in VPC (self-managed or Redwood Private).
Indexing plan: store raw clinical notes in on-prem object store; precompute embeddings in dedicated batch jobs; KV cache for recent patient contexts.

Reranker topology: two-stage retrieval -> sparse candidate generation (BM25) + dense embedding recall + lightweight transformer reranker on GPU pool. Reranker should run in private cluster with model pinned and versioned.
Observability asks: per-token cost breakdown, per-route latency + access logs with SAML user id, immutable audit export to customer SIEM daily.
Scaling ask: POC must demonstrate 100 qps sustained with 200ms median; Redwood SE asked to provide load scripts and cost estimate for Dedicated cluster with 8xA100 equiv.
Data retention: retention policies per dataset; immediate TTL for PHI-derived transient caches; long-term audit logs retention 7 years (customer requirement).
Encryption and keying: HSM-backed KMS in customer's VPC; key rotation policy and proof of zero-knowledge access by Redwood control plane.
